title: Brahmagupta's rules for zero
summary: In his book of 628, Brahmagupta treated zero as a number and gave rules for calculating with it.
why: Our zero comes from Indian maths, carried to Europe via the Islamic world.
interchange: Zero as a placeholder digit, used independently in Mesoamerica (Maya; possibly Olmec origin)

notes.problem: Maya zero was a placeholder, not zero as a number; independence is shown in the Zero article, which says it may be Olmec.
